missing_quantities: Rollout JSONL stores only input/output/score/step, not original per-action validity, parser-execution metadata, per-trajectory done/truncated reasons, traj_uid, action-token mask or token Q/V/A. These are not inferred by reparsing concatenated text.

DT readout reports do not carry explicit global_step. First three sequential complete readout calls per persistent worker are associated by original native call order and matched unique target trajectory counts with original trainer workload and complete step metrics; this is not a per-token join.

Per-rank raw group sums include DP balancing duplicate trajectories; exact deduplicated original-batch raw mean/variance cannot be recovered from these group summaries. Zero-reward trajectories have no DT calls but remain in original whole-batch whitening.
Whole-batch whitening mean/variance and raw-to-whitened per-token pairs are not persisted here. Only original actor-facing critic/advantages metrics are available.
No independent evaluation is configured for these steps; score is sampled before the corresponding update, so it cannot measure that update on the same trajectories.
